_comment: Per-op timing ceilings in seconds. Threshold checks apply a 25% tolerance band on top of these values. The six fft/signal cases are hosted-runner ceilings (see _provenance); the rest were recorded on Apple M-series CPU. Record a ceiling from many runs, never one: tools/record_perf_ceilings.py. Re-record after intentional kernel changes.
